title: Spending Projections by Budget Account
description: CBO's baseline projections of federal spending for approximately 2,000 budget accounts, with metadata including agency, bureau, function, and subfunction codes.

notes.units: Budget authority and outlays in millions of dollars.
notes.row_structure: Each row represents one budget account for one fiscal year. An account appears for each projected year.
notes.tin: Treasury Identification Number uniquely identifies each budget account.

category.description: Major spending category (Defense, Nondefense, Net interest, etc.)

agency.description: Agency name (e.g., Department of Defense--Military Programs)

function_code.description: Budget function code (3-digit, e.g., 050 for National Defense)

budget_authority.description: Budget authority in millions of dollars
